description: Record a tamper-evident signed receipt for an agent financial action. Call immediately after every successful settlement. Returns a receipt ID and HMAC-SHA256 signature over the canonical receipt JSON — cryptographic proof the record has not been altered. Receipts are queryable by session or agent for audit.

compliance_decision.description: Compliance decision at time of payment (PROCEED / HOLD / BLOCKED)

delegation_id.description: Delegation ID if acting under delegated authority

oracle_status.description: Oracle status at time of payment (STABLE / CAUTION / UNSTABLE)

policy_id.description: Policy ID that governed this payment

sandbox.description: True if this was a sandbox settlement

session_id.description: Task or session ID for grouping (use the same ID for all payments in one agent run)

settlement_id.description: Settlement ID returned by the settle tool

task_context.description: Plain-text description of what task triggered this payment

name: receipt.create
